licenceClasses.open-reuse: Apache / MIT / CC BY: adapt into lessons with attribution, a link to the licence and a note of changes.
licenceClasses.share-alike: CC BY-SA / GPL: adapt only into items published under the same licence (marked as such); otherwise summarise in our words and link.
licenceClasses.link-only: Proprietary, non-commercial (NC) or no-derivatives (ND): our own summary + a link; never copied.
licenceClasses.gated: Behind a form: link only; downloads use a research inbox, never the owner's personal email.
licenceClasses.to-verify: Not yet checked: treated as link-only until the licence is read and recorded.

rules: Atlas stays vendor-neutral: concepts from neutral sources first; a vendor's material is 'Try it on <vendor>' beside other vendors' equivalents.
No lesson draws on a single vendor.
Every lesson item records its source id, type (Read / Watch / Try) and length.
Links are checked monthly; a dead link hides the item and flags it in Admin.

AI-use terms are recorded per source (field aiUse): OpenStax states its books 'may not be used in the training of large language models or otherwise be ingested into large language models or generative AI offerings without OpenStax's permission' — so OpenStax text is never sent to a model call (no drafting from it, no retrieval index of it) without permission; our own summaries are written by people.
Licences change between editions (OpenStax Principles of Finance moved from CC BY to CC BY-NC-SA): record the edition, and re-check each source's licence when a new edition appears.
